 The Plate Semi Final 1 of the Hong Kong Sixes, 2026 was played on 31 October 2026 at Mission Road Ground, Mong Kok, where Oman beat Sri Lanka by 5 wickets.
Sri Lanka and Oman battled in a S6 contest under the ongoing Hong Kong Sixes, 2026. Final result: Oman beat Sri Lanka by 5 wickets. Toss: Oman, who chose to field Player of the Match: Zohaib Amanat ADVERTISEMENT
